text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin's debut race is here, and her younger twin sisters have come to show their support. She's the very definition of a responsible older sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Encouraged by a cute dance performance from her sisters, Ines Fujin feels ready to make them proud and do her best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no telling what will happen in the race ahead. With her heart pounding, Ines Fujin is about to make her debut!
